text: Public administration is an interdisciplinary subject that studies the laws governing the management activities of the government and public sectors. It focuses on the decision-making, organization, implementation and evaluation of public affairs, aiming to enhance the efficiency of public services and optimize policy effectiveness through scientific methods. Its core covers theories from multiple disciplines such as political science, economics, sociology, law and management, aiming to cultivate compound talents with the ability to analyze public policies, operate and manage public sectors, and innovate in social governance. The major emphasizes the integration of theory and practice, addressing practical issues such as social security, urban governance, public health, and emergency management, and serving the demands of modernizing the national governance system and governance capacity.
